shots.text: Mother Briar was the wisest healer in the Deepwood. The thorns had grown all the way through her.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The thicket-woman falling apart on the floating steps, grey flowers wilting, black thorns crumbling.

shots.text: In the thorns, bound and bleeding, was a man the Concord had exiled for murder. The Queen's own brother.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Corvin the Uncrowned cutting himself free with a black glass blade full of stars, hood back, silver hair, a scar through his eyebrow.

shots.text: I told them it was the Marshal. Six years I told them. Nobody listened... Will you?
shots.speaker: corvin
shots.art_note: Corvin standing, looking at the player. Joins as a hero.
